selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of bluish, partially keratotic papules and nodules on the lower legs, lipolymphedema, and family history of similar conditions support Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome, which is further confirmed by the detection of a heterozygous pathogenic KRIT1 variant not being exclusive to this condition but the combination of clinical and histopathological findings aligns more closely with Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome.

rejected.label: Cerebral cavernous malformation
rejected.why: The patient's primary symptoms are cutaneous and venous, not cerebral
